w10_P4_001518: An archery club needs the final figure, in kilojoules, at the foot of its bow-test sheet. The base speed b, in m/s, is the smaller value satisfying b^2 - 15*b + 56 = 0, and the limbs send the arrow away at 3 times that base speed. The arrow has a mass of 3 kg, and the range is at 17 degrees C. The energy the arrow carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. A standing instrument allowance of 14 kJ is then added to it. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001519: A laboratory needs the total energy, in joules, from a paired launcher test. The trolley's release speed, in metres per second, is the area under the curve 1*x^2 + 1*x between x = 1 and x = 4, where x is the cam setting. The trolley has a mass of 6 kg. To the energy it carries by virtue of that motion, 14 J is added for the latch and a further 15 J for the trigger coil. The laboratory runs 2 identical launchers. What is the total, in J?
w10_P4_001521: A cold-store operator is testing a roller cage on a level aisle. The cage's speed v, in m/s, is the smaller value that satisfies v^2 - 9v + 8 = 0. The cage has a mass of 44000 g, and the store is held at 4 degrees C. The energy the cage carries by virtue of its motion is expressed in kilojoules, and a charged buffer then adds 11 kJ. The operator runs 6 identical aisles. What total figure, in kJ, does the store hold?
w10_P4_001523: A gas-compressor works tests a piston on a short bore. The piston's release speed, in metres per second, is the area under the curve 5*x^2 + 2*x between x = 3 and x = 4, where x is the valve-lift index. The piston has a mass of 29 kg, and the energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. A cylinder holds 3 identical pistons, and a machine holds 12 identical cylinders. A standing instrument allowance of 25 kJ is then subtracted from the machine's figure. What is the machine's net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001525: A quarry needs the total force, in newtons, applied by its whole feeder installation. Each pan's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the sum of the whole numbers from 1 up to 9, one for each of its numbered drive steps. A pan has a mass of 171 kg, and each drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A frame carries 2 identical drives, a feeder carries 4 frames, and the installation runs 4 identical feeders. What total force, in N, does the installation apply?
w10_P4_001526: A shot-peening machine throws media from a spinning wheel. The raw index is the area under the curve 2*x^2 + 8*x between x = 2 and x = 4, where x is the wheel-setting index, and 13 is then subtracted from that index to give the media's launch speed in metres per second. A media charge has a mass of 49000 g. To the energy the charge carries by virtue of that motion, 14 J is added for the feed spout and a further 6 J for the deflector. The plant runs 6 identical machines. What total energy, in J, do the machines hold?
w10_P4_001527: A ferry terminal is rating a linkspan actuator. The span's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 9a + 20 = 0. The moving span has a mass of 65 kg, and the control room is at 19 degrees C. The actuator supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A counterweight chain adds 19 N to the actuator's load, and a guide roller then relieves 12 N. The terminal has 8 identical linkspans. What total load, in N, do the linkspans carry?
w10_P4_001533: A ropeway works is setting up a tensioning drive. Two index wheels carry 384 teeth and 289 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is set numerically equal to that number; the carriage has a mass of 91000 g, and the machine house is at 21 degrees C. The drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and a return spring adds 14 N to its load. A tower carries 9 identical drives, and a standing pre-load of 1 N is added to the tower's combined load. The works has 4 identical towers. What total load, in N, do the towers carry?
w10_P4_001535: A packaging plant launches cartons from a kicker. The carton's launch speed, in metres per second, is the area under the curve 1*x^2 + 6*x between x = 0 and x = 3, where x is the kicker index. A carton has a mass of 10000 g. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is multiplied by the 4 kickers on a lane and then by the 5 lanes in a hall. A control latch adds 24 J to the hall's total, and the plant has 8 identical halls. What total energy, in J, does the plant hold?
w10_P4_001539: A forging shop scores a hammer trial from its position record. The hammer's position along its guide is, in metres, 4*t^3 + 1*t^2 with t in seconds, and the trial is scored at the instant t = 1 s by differentiating that position 2 times. The value obtained is set as the test slug's speed in metres per second; the slug has a mass of 18 kg, and the shop is at 28 degrees C. To the energy the slug carries by virtue of that motion, 15 J is added for the gripper. The shop performs 5 strikes in a cycle and completes 3 identical cycles. What total energy, in J, does the shop record?
w10_P4_001543: A dockside vehicle ramp is being rated. The ramp carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the area under the curve 1*x^2 + 4*x between x = 0 and x = 4, where x is the lever index. The carriage has a mass of 187000 g, and the control cabin is at 15 degrees C. The drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion; a guide shoe relieves 21 N of it, and a seal relieves a further 19 N. The remainder is expressed in kilonewtons, and a standing frame relief of 14 kN is then subtracted. What is the net figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001547: A mine needs the total force, in newtons, applied across its whole hoisting section. Each skip's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the larger value satisfying a^2 - 12a + 35 = 0. A skip has a mass of 198 kg, and the hoist supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A rope guide adds 15 N to the hoist's load. A shaft carries 9 identical hoists, the mine has 12 identical shafts, and a standing frame relief of 24 N is then taken off the mine's combined figure. What total force, in N, does the hoisting section apply?
w10_P4_001550: A cable-laying vessel is rating a tensioner. The base rate b, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying b^2 - 9*b + 18 = 0, and the gearbox drives the carriage at 9 times that base rate. The carriage has a mass of 181000 g, and the deck is at 14 degrees C. The tensioner supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and the rating sheet expresses it in kilonewtons. A guide sheave then relieves 1 kN of that figure. What figure, in kN, does the rating sheet show?
w10_P4_001560: A bottling plant needs the net figure, in newtons, for its whole capping section. Each capper head has 12 mounting bosses, and its carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is set numerically equal to the number of distinct pairs of bosses that a brace could join. A carriage has a mass of 59 kg, and each head supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A machine carries 8 identical heads, a line runs 11 machines, and the plant has 12 identical lines. A standing frame relief of 30 N is then taken off the plant's combined figure. What is the net figure, in N?
w10_P4_001562: A gym-equipment maker tests a rowing carriage on a rail. The carriage's speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 5v + 6 = 0. The carriage has a mass of 25000 g. The energy it carries by virtue of its motion is expressed in kilojoules, and a charged buffer then adds 23 kJ. The maker runs 5 identical rails, and a control supply finally adds 21 kJ to their combined figure. What is the maker's total, in kJ?
w10_P4_001569: A skittle-alley manufacturer tests a ball-return kicker. The ball's launch speed, in metres per second, is the area under the curve 4*x^2 + 3*x between x = 1 and x = 3, where x is the kicker-tension index. The ball has a mass of 14000 g, and the alley is at 20 degrees C. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules, and a standing rig allowance of 3 kJ is subtracted from it. The manufacturer tests 5 identical kickers. What total figure, in kJ, do the kickers show?
w10_P4_001571: A ski-lift works tests a haul grip on a short rail. The raw index is the area under the curve 3*x^2 + 7*x between x = 0 and x = 3, where x is the drive-lever setting, and 2 is then subtracted from that index to give the grip's speed in metres per second. The grip assembly has a mass of 41 kg, and the machine house is at 12 degrees C. The energy the assembly carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. The works runs 11 identical grips. What total energy, in kJ, do the grips hold?
w10_P4_001572: A slot-car laboratory measures a test car on a straight section. The car's position along the track is, in metres, 1*t^3 + 1*t^2 with t in seconds, and the measurement is taken at the instant t = 1 s, when the car moves at whatever speed its position curve gives. The car has a mass of 36000 g. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is multiplied by the 10 cars on a lane, and the lane's figure is expressed in kilojoules. A track holds 12 identical lanes, and the laboratory has 4 identical tracks. What total energy, in kJ, does the laboratory hold?
w10_P4_001573: A leisure centre needs the net figure, in kilojoules, for a flume trial. Each raft is pushed off by 3 identical jets, and every jet contributes 8 m/s while it fires and a further 5 m/s while it eases, so the raft leaves at the accumulated speed. The raft has a mass of 20000 g. To the energy the raft carries by virtue of that motion, 1 J is added for the release gate, and 19 J is then deducted for the trough friction. The result is expressed in kilojoules, and a standing pump allowance of 18 kJ is subtracted. What is the net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001575: A dockyard needs the net figure, in kilonewtons, for a slipway winch. The base rate b, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying b^2 - 15*b + 56 = 0, and the gearbox drives the cradle at 10 times that base rate. The cradle has a mass of 163000 g, and the winch supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. That force is expressed in kilonewtons. A standing frame relief of 13 kN is then subtracted from it. What is the net figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001582: A go-kart workshop tests a launch dolly on a short rail. The base value b is the smaller solution of b^2 - 8*b + 12 = 0, the gearbox multiplies it by 7, and a drag correction then takes 5 away, giving the dolly's speed in metres per second. The dolly has a mass of 28000 g, and the workshop is at 22 degrees C. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. The workshop runs 2 identical rails. What total energy, in kJ, do the rails hold?
w10_P4_001584: A trampoline-park laboratory measures a test mass on a level guide. The mass's speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 6v + 5 = 0. The test mass is 19000 g. The energy it carries by virtue of its motion is expressed in kilojoules and multiplied by the 5 guides in the rig. A standing instrument allowance of 22 kJ is then subtracted from the rig's figure. The laboratory runs 4 identical rigs. What is the laboratory's net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001586: A crane works needs the total figure, in kilonewtons, for a hoist installation. The drum's position along its guide is, in metres, 2*t^3 + 3*t^2 with t in seconds, and the rating is taken at the instant t = 4 s by differentiating that position 2 times to give the carriage's rate of change of speed in m/s^2. The carriage has a mass of 178 kg, and the machine house is at 18 degrees C. The drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and the result is expressed in kilonewtons. A tower carries 8 identical hoists, and the works has 11 identical towers. What total figure, in kN, does the installation show?
w10_P4_001593: A cannery needs the total energy, in kilojoules, held by its whole filling section. Two index wheels carry 40 teeth and 210 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. Each can carrier is then run at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to that number, and a carrier has a mass of 8000 g. The energy one carrier holds by virtue of its motion is multiplied by the 7 carriers on a head, and the head's figure is expressed in kilojoules. A machine holds 12 identical heads, and the section has 9 identical machines. What total energy, in kJ, does the section hold?
w10_P4_001597: A ski-tow operator tests a tow bar on a straight run. The bar is brought up to speed by 3 identical drive stages, and each stage contributes 2 m/s as the clutch engages and a further 13 m/s as it drives, so the bar moves at the accumulated speed. The bar has a mass of 38000 g. From the energy it carries by virtue of that motion, 11 J is deducted for the guide friction and a further 11 J for the sheave drag. The result is expressed in kilojoules, and the tow carries 12 identical bars. What total energy, in kJ, does the tow hold?
